description: Propose a new memory. It is not stored or searchable until a person accepts it. Give the source of the claim. Name the files it is about in files, so recall can say when they change. For a decision, put the choice in text and give why (and rejected options): recall then shows why it was chosen.

files.description: Project-relative paths of the files or folders (ending in /) this memory is about. They are read when a person accepts it.

id.description: New id: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

rejected.description: kind decision only: the options that were considered and not chosen.

source_ref.description: Where the claim comes from, one line.

supersedes.description: Id of the memory this one replaces, if any.

why.description: kind decision only: why it was chosen, in one line.

name: stashpad_save
